mfrruptu.name: MFRRUPTU - MFR marker sub-cut
mfrruptu.description: One row per SKS-coded finding of rupture (e.g. uterine) for a birth in mfr.yaml, joined via FK_MFR. Backs mfr.yaml's markoer_ruptur flag.

mfrsmlin.name: MFRSMLIN - MFR marker sub-cut
mfrsmlin.description: One row per SKS-coded finding of pain relief for a birth in mfr.yaml, joined via FK_MFR. Backs mfr.yaml's markoer_smertelindring flag.

mfrultra.name: MFRULTRA - MFR marker sub-cut
mfrultra.description: One row per SKS-coded finding of ultrasound for a birth in mfr.yaml, joined via FK_MFR. Backs mfr.yaml's markoer_ultralyd flag.

mfrvestm.name: MFRVESTM - MFR marker sub-cut
mfrvestm.description: One row per SKS-coded finding of labour stimulation (oxytocin) for a birth in mfr.yaml, joined via FK_MFR. Backs mfr.yaml's markoer_vestimulation flag.

mfryvend.name: MFRYVEND - MFR marker sub-cut
mfryvend.description: One row per SKS-coded finding of external cephalic version for a birth in mfr.yaml, joined via FK_MFR. Backs mfr.yaml's markoer_ydre_vending flag.

sssy.name: Sygesikring (6-cifret)
sssy.description: The continuation of SYSI: fees settled for primary-care activity. Same shape, a few different columns. Both registers report 2005, so a study spanning the handover has to pick one source for that year or it will double-count.

sysi.name: Sygesikring (6-cifret)
sysi.description: Fees settled for primary-care activity: general practice, practising specialists, dentists, physiotherapists and so on. One row per settled service group, not one row per visit.

t_psyk_adm.name: Landspatientregistret psykiatri - administrative oplysninger
t_psyk_adm.description: One row per psychiatric hospital contact, up to March 2019. The psychiatric counterpart of lpr_adm, and separate from it: a study covering both somatic and psychiatric care has to read both registers and stack them.

t_psyk_afl.name: PSYK_AFL - Landspatientregistret psykiatri - aflyste procedurer
t_psyk_afl.description: One row per psychiatric operation/procedure that was planned and then cancelled. Carries no pnr: join to t_psyk_adm on recnum to reach the person. Structurally identical to lpr_afl.yaml, its somatic counterpart.
t_psyk_afl.grain: several rows per record in the parent table

t_psyk_diag.name: Landspatientregistret psykiatri - diagnoser
t_psyk_diag.description: One row per diagnosis on a psychiatric contact. Carries no person identifier: join to t_psyk_adm to reach the person.
t_psyk_diag.grain: several rows per record in the parent table

t_psyk_opr.name: PSYK_OPR - Landspatientregistret psykiatri - operationer efter ICD8 klassifikationen
t_psyk_opr.description: One row per psychiatric operation coded under the pre-1996 (ICD8-era) classification. Carries no pnr: join to t_psyk_adm on recnum to reach the person. Structurally identical to lpr_opr.yaml, its somatic counterpart.
t_psyk_opr.grain: several rows per record in the parent table

t_psyk_pas.name: PSYK_PAS - Landspatientregistret psykiatri - oplysninger om passiv ventetid
t_psyk_pas.description: One row per period of passive waiting time for a psychiatric contact, with a reason, its start/end dates, and which department/hospital the patient returned to when active treatment resumed. Carries no pnr: join to t_psyk_adm on recnum to reach the person. Structurally identical to lpr_pas.yaml, its somatic counterpart.
t_psyk_pas.grain: several rows per record in the parent table

t_psyk_pers.name: PSYK_PERS - Landspatientregistret psykiatri - oplysninger om ambulante besoeg
t_psyk_pers.description: One row per psychiatric outpatient (ambulant) visit, or home visit from 2003 onward, with the staff category involved, the service provided, and where it took place. A single contact can have several visits, and even several per day. Carries no pnr: join to t_psyk_adm on recnum to reach the person.
t_psyk_pers.grain: several rows per record in the parent table

t_psyk_psykio.name: PSYK_PSYKIO - Landspatientregistret psykiatri - saerlige psykiatrisk oplysninger
t_psyk_psykio.description: One row per psychiatric contact recording admission source, the legal basis for admission (e.g. voluntary vs. involuntary/committed), and discharge destination. Carries no pnr: join to t_psyk_adm on recnum to reach the person.

t_psyk_sksopr.name: PSYK_SKSOPR - Landspatientregistret psykiatri - oplysninger om operationer
t_psyk_sksopr.description: One row per psychiatric operation/procedure coded under the modern SKS system (1996 onwards). Carries no pnr: join to t_psyk_adm on recnum to reach the person.
t_psyk_sksopr.grain: several rows per record in the parent table

t_psyk_sksube.name: PSYK_SKSUBE - Landspatientregistret psykiatri - oplysninger om undersoegelser
t_psyk_sksube.description: One row per psychiatric examination/investigation coded under the modern SKS system. Carries no pnr: join to t_psyk_adm on recnum to reach the person.
t_psyk_sksube.grain: several rows per record in the parent table

t_psyk_udtilsgh.name: PSYK_UDTILSGH - Landspatientregistret psykiatri - oplysninger om sygehus og afdeling
t_psyk_udtilsgh.description: One row per contact recording the hospital and department the patient was discharged (transferred) to. Carries no pnr: join to t_psyk_adm on recnum to reach the person. Structurally identical to lpr_udtilsgh.yaml, its somatic counterpart.

t_psyk_ulyk.name: PSYK_ULYK - Landspatientregistret psykiatri - ulykkeskoder
t_psyk_ulyk.description: One row per accident/injury code on a psychiatric contact. Carries no pnr: join to t_psyk_adm on recnum to reach the person. Structurally identical to lpr_ulyk.yaml, its somatic counterpart.
t_psyk_ulyk.grain: several rows per record in the parent table

t_psyk_vente.name: PSYK_VENTE - Landspatientregistret psykiatri - ventetid
t_psyk_vente.description: One row per waiting-time period tied to a psychiatric contact, with a status and a start/end date. Carries no pnr: join to t_psyk_adm on recnum to reach the person. Structurally identical to lpr_vente.yaml, its somatic counterpart.
t_psyk_vente.grain: several rows per record in the parent table

udda.name: Uddannelser (BUE) (education register)
udda.description: One record per person per year, updated when the education changes. Holds the code for the education a person completed, not its level.
udda.grain: one row per person per period

vnds.name: Historiske vandringer (historical migrations)
vnds.description: One row per migration event per person: an immigration to or an emigration from Denmark, with the date it happened. Holds only events, so a person born in Denmark who never left has no rows at all - absence is the normal case, not missing data. Known to contain duplicates, which is why DST replaced it. Closed by DST and replaced by three registers: VNDS_IND and VNDS_UD from 2005, and VNDS_HIST for 1973-2004. VNDS itself runs to 2024, so its coverage overlaps both successors for 2005-2024. Closed by DST in February 2026 and split into VNDS_IND, VNDS_UD and VNDS_HIST. Still documented as a current register because deliveries made before the split contain only this one, which is the case for many projects.
vnds.overlap_note: Coverage overlaps the successors for 2005-2024, but they must not be combined. DST states that migration data over the years came from different sources and that this produced a number of duplicates, and that freezing the earliest data in a historical register reduces the problem. The three successors are therefore a correction of this register, not a reorganisation of it. Use either VNDS on its own, accepting the duplicates it is known to contain, or VNDS_HIST together with VNDS_IND and VNDS_UD - never a mixture.

vnds_hist.name: Historiske vandringer fra 1973 til 2004
vnds_hist.description: One row per migration event per person for 1973-2004. Frozen: DST marks it as closed, and it is not updated.

vnds_ind.name: Indvandringer (immigrations)
vnds_ind.description: One row per immigration from 2005 onwards, with the person's demographics as at the event.

vnds_ud.name: Udvandringer (emigrations)
vnds_ud.description: One row per emigration from 2005 onwards, with the person's demographics as at the event.
